_note: Rename the project here and in the README title. Everything else reads from this file.
name: AI Front Desk
tagline: One front door for AI ideas: request, route, approve, measure.
companyNote: Northwind SaaS is a fictional remote software company. Its people, requests and numbers are made up.

tools.name: Minuta
tools.does: Turns call notes into tasks for the right team, in an issue tracker or a CRM, with a follow-up email draft.
tools.when: Calls, meetings, transcripts, next steps, follow-ups after a call.

tools.name: Posta
tools.does: Reads the inbox every morning, sends a briefing of what needs you, and drafts replies in your voice. Never sends for you.
tools.when: Email overload, inbox triage, reply drafts, a morning briefing.

tools.name: Threadline
tools.does: Turns documents into a second brain, including a company handbook mode that answers from Notion pages and cites them.
tools.when: Company knowledge, handbook and policy questions, finding where something is written down.

tools.name: Signalpost
tools.does: Writes a native post per social network from a plain-words plan, checks each network's rules, and schedules only after approval.
tools.when: Social media posts, content calendars, scheduling reels and carousels.

tools.name: Plano
tools.does: Forecasts what a paid media budget buys across channels and markets.
tools.when: Paid media budgets, media plans, forecasting clicks, CPA or ROAS.

tools.name: AdsDetective
tools.does: Ranks which ads keep running in Meta's public Ad Library, a clue that they work.
tools.when: Competitor ads, ad research, which creatives work in a market.
